radius_rationale: Radius 0.30 Im(z_EP), much smaller than the distance 2 Im(z_EP) to its conjugate. Local neighbor separation, assignment margins, and the winding of the updated discriminant are checked at every sample. This is not a global exclusion theorem for other EPs.

provenance.interpretation: Analytic commutator continuation; non-CPTP for complex z. Numerical local EP evidence, not a global enumeration of EPs or a central scientific Acceptance result.
